featured_reviews.name: Harshavardhan Uchil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a truly great experience with Miqdad and Kapa Enterprises, the authorised dealership for OOB digital door locks.
My main concern was my very unique antique solid teak wood door, which is extremely precious to me and my family. I wasn’t sure at all whether an advanced digital door lock could even be installed on it. Once such a door is cut, there’s no going back if the lock doesn’t fit — so I was understandably very worried.
Miqdad and his team handled this with absolute professionalism. They assured me of the feasibility only after doing complete due diligence, which immediately built trust. On the installation day, Miqdad, his team, and their carpenter executed the work beautifully and with great care.
The lock fits perfectly, works wonderfully, and we’ve all become completely used to it already. It’s been four months, and everything is functioning flawlessly.
Thank you so much to Miqdad and the entire team. I highly recommend OOB digital locks, and even more, Miqdad and Kapa Enterprises. Their work, honesty, and attention to detail were truly impeccable.

featured_reviews.name: Aliasgar Sabuwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great experience working with Kapa Enterprise LLP. The team is professional, approachable, and very clear in their communication. Everything was handled smoothly and on time, without the usual follow-ups or confusion.

What I really appreciated was their attention to detail and willingness to understand requirements properly before execution. You can tell they care about doing the job right, not just closing it quickly.

Definitely a dependable team and someone I’d be happy to work with again. Highly recommended!
